description:
Who is listed at a commercial address or around it, and whether each is an independent or part of a chain. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "What businesses are near 3800 Grand Ave S, Minneapolis?"
- "How many independent shops within a mile of this site?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every listed business; independent: independents only; chain: part of a chain. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: businesses_at_address
title: Businesses at an Address
